description: Find scheduled flights by route and date when the flight number is NOT known: origin airport, destination airport, local departure date, and optionally an airline. Returns matching flights with their flight numbers so the exact flight can then be added via flight_quickadd. Use flight_quickadd_lookup instead when the user already has the full flight number.

airline_code.description: Optional IATA airline code filter, such as W6 for Wizz Air.

date.description: Local departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

destination.description: Arrival airport IATA code, such as SKG.

origin.description: Departure airport IATA code, such as BUD.

name: flight_route_lookup
title: Flight Route Lookup
